name: Big Bang
description: The universe begins from an infinitely dense singularity. Space, time, matter, and energy spring into existence.

name: Cosmic Inflation
description: The universe expands exponentially in a fraction of a second, growing from subatomic to macroscopic scales.

name: Quark Era Ends
description: Quarks bind together to form protons and neutrons. The fundamental building blocks of matter solidify.

name: First Atoms Form
description: 380,000 years after the Big Bang, the universe cools enough for electrons to bind to nuclei. The universe becomes transparent for the first time.

name: Cosmic Dark Ages
description: The universe is dark and formless — no stars yet, just a slowly cooling fog of hydrogen and helium.

name: First Stars Born
description: Population III stars ignite — massive, brilliant, and short-lived. They forge the first heavy elements in their cores.

name: First Galaxies Form
description: Gravity pulls matter into the first protogalaxies. The cosmic web begins to take shape.

name: Reionization Era
description: Ultraviolet light from early stars and quasars ionizes the intergalactic medium. The universe becomes fully transparent.

name: Milky Way Forms
description: Our galaxy assembles over billions of years from merging smaller galaxies and accreted gas clouds.

name: Solar System Forms
description: A molecular cloud collapses to form the Sun. A protoplanetary disk of gas and dust swirls around it, seeding the planets.

name: Earth Forms
description: Planetesimals collide and accrete to form a young, molten Earth. The Moon forms from a giant impact with a Mars-sized body.

name: Late Heavy Bombardment
description: The inner solar system is pelted by asteroids and comets, potentially delivering water and organic molecules to Earth.

name: First Life on Earth
description: Simple single-celled organisms appear in Earth's oceans. Life's 4-billion-year journey begins.

name: Photosynthesis Evolves
description: Cyanobacteria evolve photosynthesis, slowly pumping oxygen into the atmosphere and transforming Earth forever.

name: Great Oxidation Event
description: Atmospheric oxygen rises dramatically, killing most anaerobic life but enabling complex aerobic organisms.

name: Eukaryotic Cells
description: Cells with a nucleus and organelles emerge — a quantum leap in biological complexity.

name: Multicellular Life
description: Simple multicellular organisms appear. For the first time, cells cooperate to form a unified organism.

name: Cambrian Explosion
description: In just 20 million years, most major animal body plans appear. The fossil record explodes with diversity.

name: First Land Plants
description: Plants colonize dry land, transforming barren rock into lush ecosystems and beginning to terraform the planet.

name: Age of Fish
description: The Devonian period — vertebrates diversify explosively in the oceans. The first fish with jaws emerge.

name: First Forests
description: Dense forests of giant tree ferns cover the continents. Atmospheric oxygen peaks, enabling giant insects.

name: First Reptiles
description: Amniote eggs evolve, freeing vertebrates from water for reproduction. Reptiles begin their conquest of land.

name: Great Dying
description: The Permian-Triassic extinction — 96% of all marine species and 70% of land vertebrates perish. Life nearly ends.

name: Age of Dinosaurs
description: Dinosaurs rise to dominance following the Triassic extinction. They will reign for 165 million years.

name: First Mammals
description: Small, shrew-like mammals emerge alongside the dinosaurs, living in their shadow for 160 million years.

name: First Flowering Plants
description: Angiosperms evolve and rapidly diversify, transforming Earth's ecosystems and co-evolving with insects.

name: Chicxulub Impact
description: A 10-km asteroid strikes Mexico. The resulting nuclear winter kills 75% of all species, including non-avian dinosaurs.

name: Mammals Diversify
description: With dinosaurs gone, mammals rapidly diversify into the ecological niches left vacant, including the ancestors of whales, bats, and primates.

name: First Primates
description: Small, tree-dwelling primates appear. Forward-facing eyes, grasping hands — the first hints of the human lineage.

name: Grasslands Spread
description: Earth cools. Vast grasslands replace forests. This sets the stage for the evolution of bipedal apes on the African savanna.

name: First Hominins
description: The human and chimpanzee lineages diverge. Our ancestors begin walking upright on the African savanna.

name: Homo habilis
description: The first stone tools appear. Homo habilis — 'handy man' — begins shaping rocks into cutting instruments.

name: Homo erectus
description: Homo erectus masters fire and spreads from Africa across Asia and Europe — the first great human migration.

name: Modern Humans Emerge
description: Homo sapiens appear in Africa ~300,000 years ago. Larger brains, complex language, abstract thought.

name: Cave Art
description: Humans paint the walls of Chauvet and Lascaux caves — the birth of art, symbol, and imagination.

name: Agriculture Begins
description: The Neolithic Revolution — humans begin farming in the Fertile Crescent, radically transforming human society.

name: First Cities
description: Uruk, Jericho, Çatalhöyük — the first permanent cities arise. Writing, mathematics, and civilization emerge.

name: Writing Invented
description: Sumerian cuneiform — the first writing system. Humanity gains the ability to record and transmit knowledge across generations.

name: Classical Antiquity
description: Ancient Greece and Rome flourish. Philosophy, democracy, mathematics, and science take root.

name: Scientific Revolution
description: Copernicus, Galileo, Newton. Humans discover they live on a pale blue dot orbiting an average star.

name: Industrial Revolution
description: Steam power, fossil fuels, and machinery transform human civilization. The pace of change accelerates exponentially.

name: Space Age Begins
description: Sputnik 1 — humanity reaches orbit for the first time. We become a spacefaring species.

name: Humans on the Moon
description: Apollo 11 — humans set foot on another world for the first time. One small step for man...

name: Internet Age
description: The World Wide Web connects humanity in a global nervous system. Information becomes instantaneously universal.

name: Present Moment
description: You are here. In the last fraction of the last second of the last minute of December 31st of the Cosmic Calendar.
